candidates.text: In Heller, we held that the Second Amendment protects the right to possess a handgun in the home for the purpose of self-defense
candidates.speaker: Alito, plurality
phrases: Due Process Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment incorporates the Second Amendment right recognized in Heller

candidates.text: The notion that a constitutional provision that guarantees only `process' before a person is deprived of life
candidates.speaker: Thomas, concurring
phrases: strains credulity for even the most casual user of words

candidates.text: Self-defense is a basic right, recognized by many legal systems from ancient times to the present day
candidates.speaker: Alito
phrases: Self-defense is a basic right, recognized by many legal systems

candidates.text: The notion that the absence of a coherent theory of the Due Process Clause will somehow curtail judicial caprice
candidates.speaker: Scalia, concurring
phrases: Indeterminacy means opportunity for courts to impose whatever rule they like

candidates.text: In sum, the Framers did not write the Second Amendment in order to protect a private right of armed self-defense
